text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My skin's a total mess right now.
Super bad vibes...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Jeez! It'll be a disaster if I get a sunburn out of this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A sun visor, arm covers,
and I've gotta buy a new pair of sunglasses too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, and here I wanted to enjoy the wind more.
*sigh*...

Maruzensky seems to be
troubled by skin issues.
